import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import re
import warnings
import glob

# Configuration
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
OUTPUT_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

def find_file(prefix):
    matches = glob.glob(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, f"{prefix}*"))
    return sorted(matches)[0] if matches else os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, f"{prefix}.csv")

TRAIN_PATH = find_file("ru_train")
TEST_PATH = find_file("ru_test")
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = find_file("ru_sample_submission")

print(f"Resolved paths -> Train: {TRAIN_PATH}, Test: {TEST_PATH}, Sample: {SAMPLE_SUB_PATH}")


def load_data():
    print("Loading datasets...")
    df_train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
    df_test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)
    
    # Clean missing normalized text
    df_train.dropna(subset=["after"], inplace=True)
    df_train.reset_index(drop=True, inplace=True)
    print(f"Loaded train: {len(df_train)} rows, test: {len(df_test)} rows")
    return df_train, df_test, sample_sub


def infer_class(before_series):
    """Enhanced heuristic class inference with vectorized regex matching."""
    s = before_series.astype(str)
    cls = pd.Series("PLAIN", index=s.index)
    
    # Punctuation
    mask = s.str.match(r"^[\.,;:!?\(\)…\"—\-]+$", na=False)
    cls[mask] = "PUNCT"
    
    # Transliteration markers
    mask = s.str.contains("_trans", na=False)
    cls[mask] = "TRANS"
    
    # Cardinal numbers
    mask = s.str.match(r"^\d+$", na=False)
    cls[mask] = "CARDINAL"
    
    # Decimals (dot or comma separator)
    mask = s.str.match(r"^\d+[.,]\d+$", na=False)
    cls[mask] = "DECIMAL"
    
    # Time HH:MM or HH.MM
    mask = s.str.match(r"^\d{1,2}[:.]\d{2}$", na=False)
    cls[mask] = "TIME"
    
    # Date expressions with month names (Jan-Dec variants)
    months = r"(?:янв|фев|мар|апр|мая?|июн|июл|авг|сен|окт|ноя|дек)"
    mask = s.str.match(rf"^\d{{1,2}}\s+{months}", na=False, case=False)
    cls[mask] = "DATE"
    
    # Numeric dates DD.MM.YYYY or DD/MM/YYYY
    mask = s.str.match(r"^\d{1,2}[./]\d{1,2}[./]\d{2,4}$", na=False)
    cls[mask] = "DATE"
    
    # Ordinals (common Russian inflectional suffixes)
    mask = s.str.match(r"^.{1,12}(ый|ая|ое|ее|ой|ей|ий|ья|ьи|ым|ями?)$", na=False)
    cls[mask] = "ORDINAL"
    
    # Currency/Money indicators
    mask = s.str.match(r"^[\$\€\£\¥\₽\₴]|^(\d+\s*(руб|долл|евро))", na=False, case=False)
    cls[mask] = "MONEY"
    
    return cls


def build_mapping(df, class_col="infer_class"):
    """Constructs dual-layer lookup dictionaries for fast vectorized inference."""
    temp = df.copy()
    temp["tok_str"] = temp["before"].astype(str)
    temp["aft_str"] = temp["after"].astype(str)
    temp["cls_str"] = temp[class_col].astype(str)
    
    # Layer 1: (Token, Class) -> Best Normalization
    pair_counts = temp.groupby(["tok_str", "cls_str", "aft_str"]).size().reset_index(name="cnt")
    pair_counts.sort_values("cnt", ascending=False, inplace=True)
    pair_best = pair_counts.drop_duplicates(subset=["tok_str", "cls_str"], keep="first")
    pair_keys = pair_best["tok_str"] + "|" + pair_best["cls_str"]
    pair_dict = dict(zip(pair_keys, pair_best["aft_str"]))
    
    # Layer 2: Token -> Best Normalization (Global Fallback)
    global_counts = temp.groupby("tok_str")["aft_str"].apply(lambda x: x.value_counts().index[0])
    global_dict = global_counts.to_dict()
    
    print(f"Model constructed: {len(pair_dict)} pair mappings, {len(global_dict)} global mappings.")
    return pair_dict, global_dict

    # Fallback 2: Raw token itself (handles unseen completely)

    preds[missing] = tk[missing]
    
    return preds.fillna("")
